name: Clay Regazzoni
features: dark hair, heavy moustache, broad face, strong build, gap-toothed grin
bio: The Ticinese bruiser who arrived at Ferrari in 1970 and won the Italian Grand Prix in his fifth race. In the 512S he was the works team's charger, second at Sebring and Monza, and the driver Ferrari sent out when somebody had to catch a 917.
